written.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
written.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, a new payment feature that lets its "dots" AI agents make purchases on behalf of users. The feature is initially available to U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers ages 18 and older.

written.headline: Nscale reports $5.5B in debt and $1.69B loss in amended IPO filing
written.summary: AI cloud provider Nscale reported $5.5 billion in total debt for September and a nine-month net loss of $1.69 billion in an amended IPO prospectus. Nvidia committed $2 billion of over $3 billion in convertible financing to support Nscale amid its obligations for a $44.6 billion Anthropic contract.

written.headline: SpaceX lays off ~60 Grok Imagine staffers to prioritize AI coding tools
written.summary: SpaceX laid off about 60 employees from its Grok Imagine video-generation team, leaving a handful of staffers to maintain the product. The cuts are part of an ongoing reorganization following xAI's merger into SpaceX in February 2026.

written.headline: Scott Bessent says Treasury and other departments pushed to blacklist Megaspeed
written.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that Treasury, Defense, State, and the U.S. Trade Representative favored placing Chinese AI company Megaspeed on the export control entity list for months. However, the Commerce Department did not act on the request.

written.headline: DeepX tapes out DX-M2 edge AI chip for 100B‑parameter LLMs at under 5 W
written.summary: South Korean startup DeepX has taped out its second‑generation AI accelerator DX‑M2, designed to run 20‑100 billion‑parameter language models on robots and drones using about 5 W. Mass production is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027.
